bootstrap.title: Create the portal administrator
bootstrap.description: This new portal is reserved for its designated administrator. Create that account first; you will configure the portal after signing in.

editor.logoSection: Logos for the selected color mode

assetDescriptions.markLight: Square icon for compact UI elements on light backgrounds, such as the login and signup screens.
assetDescriptions.markDark: Square icon for compact UI elements on dark backgrounds, such as the login and signup screens.
assetDescriptions.logoLight: Wide logo for headers and pages with a light background.
assetDescriptions.logoDark: Wide logo for headers and pages with a dark background.

modules.timesheetsDescription: Register hours by employee, client, project, and activity.
modules.invoicesDescription: Create, manage, send, and track customer invoices.
modules.serviceRequestsDescription: Let customers submit requests and follow their progress.
modules.invoiceTimesheetsDescription: Turn approved timesheet entries into invoice lines; requires Timesheets and Invoices.
modules.preserved: Data is preserved when this module is disabled.
modules.invoiceProductsDescription: Issue portal invoices for product purchases.
modules.planningDescription: Book service appointments with provider availability and calendars.

review.description: Completing setup opens the configured public pages and the rest of the portal.

messages.invalidImage: Use a valid PNG, JPEG, or WebP image smaller than 2 MB.
messages.imageTooLarge: The image dimensions must not exceed 2400×2400 pixels.
messages.markTooSmall: Compact icons must be at least 64×64 pixels.

clients.description: Choose whether this portal serves organizations, private persons, or both.
clients.existing: A type cannot be disabled while clients of that type exist, including archived clients.
clients.registrationDescription: Verified users can complete personal onboarding and open their own client account. When disabled, you can still create and invite private clients.
clients.registrationDisabled: Self-registration requires open registration in the authentication configuration.

languages.label: Supported UI languages
languages.help: Choose at least one language for the portal interface. If the current language is disabled, the portal switches to the first supported language.

appearance.presetHint: Choose a deliberate starting point, then customize any detail below.
appearance.businessDescription: Clear system typography, focused orange actions, and neutral surfaces.
appearance.softEditorialDescription: Elegant headings, lavender surfaces, and sea-blue accents.
appearance.commonHint: Set who controls the color mode and choose the primary action colors.
appearance.advancedHint: Fine-tune typography, shape, header branding, accents, and surfaces.
appearance.logoFallback: Uses the icon and portal name when a full logo is unavailable.
appearance.previewHint: Draft appearance only. Changes are published when you save.
appearance.sampleDescription: Your information and next steps, together in one place.
